mentions.name: Desplega (desplega.ai)
mentions.description: A QA agent that helps teams ship fast without compromising quality. It integrates into CI, exposes MCP for local development, and supports both an autonomous test creation mode (called discovery) and guided test creation. An in-house engine generates the tests, speeding up and improving the more it is used.
mentions.problem: In the era of vibe-coding, maintaining quality is key; the product removes the burden of QA from teams while they ship fast.
mentions.source_excerpt: We are building https://desplega.ai which is a QA agent that help teams ship fast without compromising quality.
